Subject: Re: RetailBridge DPA - recommended approach

Ben — thanks for the ping. Quick read + recommended approach below.

Summary of our position (recommended counter):
- Retention: Counter with 3 years post-termination. 5 years is unusually long; 3 years aligns with our data minimization policy and past precedent. If they insist, escalate to Sales Ops for deal-level concession.
- Subprocessors: Propose to accept notice + 14 days to object. 30 days is too long operationally; 10 days is often tight for customers to respond, 14 days is reasonable compromise.
- Audit/SOC2: We can provide a redacted SOC 2 Type II report and a SOC 2 bridge letter if timeframe is tight. We cannot provide live audit access to infrastructure; we can offer to host a recorded walkthrough and provide specific evidence spits (encryption, access logs).
- SCCs / cross-border: Accept standard EU SCCs with our annex (we'll need Privacy to prepare).

Routing for signature (recommended):
1) RetailBridge signs via DocuSign (their preferred).
2) Sales (Ben) confirms PO/contract is attached.
3) Redwood Legal (me) signs as Authorized Legal.
4) If retention is extended to 5 years or additional indemnities/LI caps change, require VP Product or CFO approval (we'll flag).

Action items for internal:
- Neha: prepare SCCs/annex and SOC2 evidence bundle (redacted report + bridge letter).
- Laura: confirm whether account needs an exception for retention longer than 3 years and if Sales Ops will approve concession.
- Ben: propose final counter language to Alex (I can draft) and confirm e-sign preference.

Link to template DPA for quick redline: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1a2b-template-dpa (internal)

Marissa Cole

Alex — thanks for the redline. Appreciate the clarity on your ask. We've reviewed internally and propose the following counter (high level):

- Retention: Redwood can accept 3 years post-termination. If RetailBridge requires 5 years, please confirm and we'll put that to Sales Ops for formal approval (may impact pricing).
- Subprocessors: Accept notice + 14-day objection window. We'll list our subprocessors in an annex and commit to adding new ones within the notice period.
- Audit: We'll provide a redacted SOC 2 Type II report and a bridge letter covering the most relevant controls. For detailed controls evidence, we can provide a scoped evidence package on request; we can't grant live infra access.

We're happy to route via DocuSign — that works for us. Attached is a counternote (RB_DPA_Counter_20270802.docx) with the specific language changes Marissa recommended. If you accept the 3-year retention and 14-day subprocessor window, we can push an e-sign packet today and target signature by end of week.

Please confirm preferred signers and whether you want RetailBridge's Legal to drive the DocuSign envelope or would you prefer Redwood to initiate?

Thanks — Ben
